steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each responsibility is matched to a capability, and each capability to the job.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.notChecked: Whether the role will work in practice.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] role-ops-manager.md:12  Capability not job-related.
       Fix: Remove it from the profile.
[medium] capability-skills.md:19  Responsibility with no capability.
       Fix: Name the capability it needs.
[low] purpose.md:26  Purpose statement missing.
       Fix: Write the purpose.
Not checked: Whether the role will work in practice.
pros: Checks a responsibility with no capability, and a capability not job-related.
cons: Not checked: Whether the role will work in practice.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-role-design skill on the records for this review.
